tools.name: workflow_state
tools.description: Whether the Agent Bridge is running, where it lives, and the app version. Use this first if anything else fails.

tools.name: workflow_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks with status, priority, project and due date.

tools.name: workflow_get_task
tools.description: One task in full, with its checklist and comment thread. Accepts a task id or a fragment of its title.

tools.name: workflow_queue
tools.description: Your inbox as "Companion": tasks assigned to Companion, tasks whose recent comments say @Companion, and notes that say @Companion — each with why it's here, its status line, checklist and latest comment. Work meant for another agent (such as Claude on the Mac) is not yours.

tools.name: workflow_poll_comments
tools.description: Comments the user has written recently, ignoring the agent's own. Defaults to the last 24 hours.

tools.name: workflow_create_task
tools.description: Create a task. Set assignee to "Companion" to put it in your own queue.

comment.description: An opening comment on the new task

tools.name: workflow_comment
tools.description: Post a comment on a task, authored as the agent. This is how you reply to the user — it reaches their phone as a notification.

tools.name: workflow_set_status_line
tools.description: Set a task's pinned note — the one-line 'where this stands' shown above its comments. Overwrite it as work progresses rather than commenting each time.

tools.name: workflow_check_subtasks
tools.description: Tick subtasks off a task (or untick them), so progress on a long job is visible on the task's own row.

tools.name: workflow_add_subtasks
tools.description: Add subtasks to an existing task's checklist.

tools.name: workflow_update_task
tools.description: Change an existing task. Only the fields you pass are touched. 'notes' REPLACES the notes; prefer 'append_notes', which adds to the end and keeps the user's formatting. 'add_tags'/'remove_tags' edit tags one at a time without dropping ones the user added.

notes.description: replaces the notes; empty string clears them

append_notes.description: added to the end of the notes

project.description: empty string removes it from its project

tools.name: workflow_remove_subtasks
tools.description: Delete rows from a task's checklist. Each entry must be an exact title or a fragment only one row contains; anything ambiguous is left alone.

tools.name: workflow_draft_email
tools.description: Prepare an email a task asks for. It is attached to the task as a draft the user checks and sends with Review & Send; nothing is sent from here. Refused unless the user has set Settings → Agent Bridge → Email to Draft Only or Can Send.

tools.name: workflow_rename_subtask
tools.description: Retitle one subtask in place, keeping its tick state — for correcting a row's wording (a version line on an index, say) without adding a duplicate.

from.description: current title, exact or a fragment it contains

tools.name: workflow_complete_task
tools.description: Mark a task complete.

tools.name: workflow_create_project
tools.description: Create a project, or update an existing one of the same name.

start.description: planned start yyyy-MM-dd, or 'none' to clear

target.description: target date yyyy-MM-dd, or 'none' to clear

tools.name: workflow_list_notes
tools.description: The Notepad. A '*' marks notes addressed to you (containing @Companion).

tools.name: workflow_get_note
tools.description: One note in full.

tools.name: workflow_create_note
tools.description: File a note in the Notepad. Where output that isn't work belongs — a summary, a finding, a set of options. Use a task instead for anything that needs doing.

tools.name: workflow_reply_note
tools.description: Answer a Notepad note inside the note itself: appends a signed, dated reply without changing what the user wrote. Notes have no comment thread, so this is how a note gets an answer on the user's phone.

tools.name: workflow_convert_note
tools.description: Promote a note into a task, keeping the note and linking the two. Converting is what takes a note out of the inbox.

tools.name: workflow_attach_file
tools.description: Attach a local file to a task (a report, a document, an image). The file is copied into the bridge folder and consumed by the app.

file.description: Path to the file on this computer

name.description: Display name; defaults to the filename

tools.name: workflow_list_projects
tools.description: The portfolio: every project's status, planned dates, progress and health (overdue / atRisk / idle / onTrack / planning / onHold / done) with the reason, as the Projects tab shows it.

tools.name: workflow_list_documents
tools.description: List or search documents — every file on a task, on a note, or filed in a project's workspace. The query matches names, document numbers (WF-4F2A91), profiles and the text inside PDFs, scans and text files.

tools.name: workflow_get_document
tools.description: One document in full: profile, folder, every version with its comment, and the start of its text.

tools.name: workflow_update_document
tools.description: Change a document's profile or folder. Profile fields apply to every version; 'name' renames the current file. Folders nest with '/', and '' unfiles.

type.description: Contract, Agreement, Invoice, Quote, Receipt, Letter, Email, Report, Proposal, Minutes, Specification, Drawing, Photo, Form, Policy, Other — or your own

status.description: Draft, In Review, Final, Signed, Superseded

tools.name: workflow_file_document
tools.description: File a local file straight into a project's workspace (not onto a task), with an optional profile and folder.

file.description: Path to the file on this computer

tools.name: workflow_add_document_version
tools.description: Upload a new version of a document. The current file is kept in its history; the profile and folder carry over.

file.description: Path to the file on this computer

tools.name: workflow_watch
tools.description: Set a task aside and be woken to look at it again later: "tell me when the release merges, check every hour", "remind me at 15:00". Give minutes from now or a time (ISO-8601, or HH:MM today). At that time a session starts on this task with "your watch came due"; check the condition, tell the user if it's met, and call this again to re-arm, since a watch fires once. clear: true ends one. Write in the task's status line what you're watching for, so a later session knows. Needs WorkFlow 5.4.

note.description: What you're watching for, shown on the task

tools.name: workflow_hand_off
tools.description: Hand a task to another assistant (Claude, or a companion such as Jarvis) or to a person: it becomes the assignee and a comment says so, with your note. Handing to an assistant @mentions it, which starts its session. Use this rather than an @mention in a comment when the work itself should move to them.

note.description: What they need to know or do

tools.name: workflow_house_rules
tools.description: The user's house rules: standing instructions for every assistant, set in WorkFlow (Settings → Agent Bridge → House Rules). Read them before starting work. Only the user can change them.

tools.name: workflow_monitor
tools.description: Checks that run on this computer every few minutes without using Claude, and wake you only when something changes: a website (http), a port (host:port), free disk space (disk, min_free_gb), a running process, or a file changing. Changes are posted on the task you name. action: add | list | remove. Command monitors can only be added by the person at this computer.

target.description: URL, host:port, folder, process name or file

wake.description: start a session when it changes

expect_text.description: http: text the page must contain

tools.name: workflow_request_approval
tools.description: Ask the user to approve one command before it runs on this computer (restart a service, install an update, delete old backups). Posts the exact command on the task with a code; when the user replies "approve CODE" you're woken, and workflow_run_approved runs exactly that command. Only the user's reply counts. Off unless the user has switched approvals on here.

action.description: what it does, in plain words

tools.name: workflow_check_approval
tools.description: Whether the user has approved or declined an approval request (by its code).

tools.name: workflow_run_approved
tools.description: Run a command the user has approved, exactly as it was when they approved it. Once only. Returns its exit code and output; report the result in the task's thread.

tools.name: workflow_doctor
tools.description: Check the companion on this computer end to end (sign-in, WorkFlow publishing and answering, version, scheduled jobs, Claude Code, last session, monitors) and say how to fix anything wrong. Use it when something isn't working.

tools.name: workflow_ping
tools.description: Confirm the app is watching the bridge (round-trips one command).
